facts.fact: In 2024 ARME granted two new general authorisations for electronic communications services, one to Starlink Cabo Verde, which started activity in January 2025.
Starlink Cabo Verde, which started activity in January 2025, held 0.2% of the internet market at end June 2025 per ARME's Q2 2025 indicators (a market share, not a subscriber count).
